name: tavernweave-agent-skills
description: A routed SillyTavern and Vibe Coding system with 20 focused skills, bounded brainstorming, immutable growth reflection, a complete screened frontend and motion library, resumable authority, host front-door adapters, evidence gates, and portable Soul modes.

interface.shortDescription: Design, build, verify, and learn SillyTavern rolecards.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeave combines 20 focused skills with bounded brainstorming, total-design and scale-aware blueprint contracts, immutable Vibe Code growth reflection, resumable creative authority, layered acceptance evidence, a complete screened ST/frontend/motion library with deterministic bounded search and an offline picker, optional global Host Front Doors, and current-task Atong, MTTT.sir, Soul Killer, or three-seat ensemble modes.
defaultPrompt: 脑暴模式，Soul 联席：帮我把这个想法收束成总设计案、第一版合同和不会递归膨胀的执行蓝图。
按蓝图开跑第一版；只执行已确认的 First Playable，运行时不要新增子蓝图。
照镜子：从当前可用证据重新核验我的完整 Vibe Code 成长历程；同时给我一份完整文字评估表单和七章交互报告，如有旧履历，只比较量表可比的维度。
阿瞳助我！用当前任务级温柔指导模式帮我完成这张角色卡。
MTTT.sir，拷打我！检查我是否真的理解这次 Vibe Code 的架构与验收。
灵魂杀手！用强尼·银手彩蛋人格审查这个前端，并给出最多三条有证据的 Relic 故障。
